settings.name: computer-use.enabled
settings.title: Computer use (preview)
settings.description: Lets agents see the screen and use the pointer and keyboard, after you allow each conversation and each app. While it is off, agents get no computer use tools.

settings.name: computer-use.showBorder
settings.title: Show a border while an agent uses the computer
settings.description: Shows a thin border in the accent colour around every display while an agent controls the screen, so you can see at a glance that computer use is active. Agents' screenshots never show it.
